ABOUT US
Bamburi Cement Ltd
A subsidiary of LafargeHolcim, the world leader in building materials. Plants
located in Mombasa and Athi River
Hima Cement
Uganda based subsidiary with a fully Integrated Plant in Kasese
Bamburi Special Products
Wholly owned subsidiary of the Bamburi Cement Limited and the largest
supplier of Ready Mix Concrete and Precast blocks
Lafarge Eco Systems
Wholly owned subsidiary of the Bamburi Cement Limited, focusing on
sustainability of land use, quarry rehabilitation and Biodiversity Management.
Provides market leadership in environmental responsibility as well as a point
of engagement for neighbouring communities and other stakeholders
